apps.name: Tellio
apps.subtitle: A free player for your own addons and IPTV account.
apps.localizedDescription:
Tellio plays what you bring: your IPTV provider's login or M3U playlist for live TV, and your addons for films and series. On top of that it adds artwork, a proper TV guide, sports with live scores, Top Shelf, Trakt sync and more.

Tellio doesn't include any channels, films or streams. It only plays what your own IPTV account and addons provide.

versions.localizedDescription:
Tidier addon rows on a match's page- #11

Some all-in-one addons list a match inside a channel name, with the teams in brackets. Tellio stripped the brackets, so those listings showed as channels, with long raw stream names and the addon's name twice. Generic sport channels also filled the "may be showing it" section.

What changed
Matches in brackets: a bracket that names two sides ("Example TV 05 [Club A vs. Club B]") is now read for the teams instead of being dropped. Brackets like "[HD]" are still ignored.
Row titles: such a listing shows the match as the title and the channel underneath. Country prefixes ("US| ", "UK: ") and leading tags ("(FHD) : ") are removed.
Line under the title: emoji, tip text and the addon's repeated name are removed, and the quality stays. If the name gives nothing useful, the stream's title or description is used instead.
"Channels for this sport · may be showing it": hidden when an addon already found the match or a channel showing it. Otherwise it leaves out news channels and lists ESPN's broadcasters first, up to 6.
Duplicates combined: the same match or channel becomes one row, even from a single addon. The source chooser labels each source by quality and label, with "Source N" only as a last resort (translated).
Tests on GitHub: the matching checks are now in Tests/Matching with Scripts/test-matching.sh. A new Tests workflow runs them on Linux for pull requests that touch the matching code.

Only mark the followed teams actually playing in a competition's game

Fixes a bug from #9, reported by a tester: ongoing games from a followed competition showed under Today as well as in the competition's row.

todaysGames passed every followed team as playing in each competition game, so the games got the followed teams' names. Once kicked off, they were picked up as the followed teams' games under way, and they could also show as a team's next match in My Teams and among the Top Shelf's live games.

Now each game only names the followed teams actually in it, of the same sport (team ids repeat across sports). A followed team's own game still shows in both Today and its competition's row, as intended.

One file, no view changes; builds in the iOS app.
